DJ CLAY - SPEAKER BASS ATTACK
8 synthesized arcade effects; 44.1 kHz 16-bit mono WAV.

01: Chest button click and confirmation chirp.
02: Speaker charging sweep.
03: Three bass blast variants (short, medium, heavy). Harmonics reinforce the bass on smaller speakers.
04: Three combined attacks: button at 0.00 seconds, charge at 0.06 seconds, bass blast at 0.50 seconds. Sync the chest-button frame to 0.00 and the speaker firing frame to 0.50.

Use either one full attack OR the separate components, not both at once. Separate components let the game trigger each sound on its matching animation event. These are synthesized sound-design assets, not recorded speaker effects.
